title: We gave AI agents a mobile dev environment
summary: Mauricio de Meirelles and David Cortes describe giving each River session an isolated, warm remote Mac, a browser-accessible live Simulator, and recordings of behavior before and after a change. An iOS team can require runtime evidence in agent PRs and encode remote-machine access in its workflow; Shopify reports reducing environment startup from over 30 minutes to a few minutes.
takeaway: Give each agent an isolated, prebuilt Mac environment and require it to reproduce, record, fix, and replay a bug before human review.
